title: What to rebuild

milestone.title: Visual Studio and the Build Pipeline

description:
Work out which files must be recompiled after a change, like a build system does.

```
change world.h
-> recompile world.cpp, player.cpp, main.cpp (they include it)
-> relink game.exe
change main.cpp -> recompile main.cpp, relink
```
hints: For each `.cpp`, walk its includes recursively and see whether you reach the changed file (lesson 4.02).
Remember visited headers so a header included twice is only walked once.
requirements: Each source lists the headers it includes, and headers can include headers.
A changed header marks every source that includes it, directly or indirectly.
Print the compile list sorted and then the link step.
stretch: Use file times: rebuild a `.cpp` when any file it includes is newer than its `.obj`.
